features.normal_activation: raw multiaddr async_connect and peer-store direct dialing through the node-owned scheduler
features.configuration: node address resolution bounds, DNS resolver nameservers and direct dial policy; private-network candidates are TCP-only
features.resource_ownership: one logical dial reservation and deadline cover recursive multi-root expansion and bounded deduplicated concrete attempts
features.persistence: peer_store retains canonical unexpanded source roots and their attributable outcomes, not temporary resolved children; each logical dial expands roots anew
features.maintenance: node lifecycle stops scheduler admission and cancellation-resistant drains attempts before session teardown; expansion state is operation-local
features.diagnostics: node snapshot exposes scheduler black-hole status and authenticated session endpoints; DNS, filtered, unlaunched and canceled targets do not prove root failure
features.intended_disposition: preserve integrated runtime ownership; require exact-head native and private Go/Rust DNSADDR evidence before readiness promotion; registration is not a passing result or a dual-stack/black-hole interop claim

features.normal_activation: node-owned direct dial scheduler ranks and staggers deduplicated concrete targets after multi-root expansion in native and private profiles
features.configuration: node direct_dial ranker policy and max_concurrent_attempts; per-logical-dial deadline and concrete launch limit; private candidates are TCP-only
features.resource_ownership: one logical reservation covers concurrent concrete attempts; authenticated losers and canceled attempts are drained before return or scheduler close
features.persistence: winner feedback credits canonical source roots, never temporary resolved children; launch and progress state is operation-local
features.maintenance: bounded launch offsets and TCP progress holds share the logical deadline; owner stop cancels admission and joins attempts before session teardown
features.diagnostics: node snapshots expose logical dial resources, native attempt counts and authenticated session endpoints
features.intended_disposition: retain implemented host-local scheduling with readiness unverified until final-head acceptance; p2p_dual_stack_dns_tcp_race_preserves_logical_ownership_and_drains_loser exercises real authoritative A/AAAA, stalled IPv6 and authenticated IPv4 echo in native/private profiles; deterministic ranker/scheduler coverage is not Go/Rust wire evidence

features.normal_activation: node-owned scheduler filters public IPv6 candidates in native and TCP-only private profiles while retaining periodic probes
features.configuration: node direct_dial.black_holes bounded window and minimum successes; private normalization preserves ipv6_enabled
features.resource_ownership: one outcome per deduplicated concrete target; suppressed candidates do not launch or reserve native resources; attempts drain before terminal completion
features.persistence: bounded detector history is scheduler-owned memory, not learned peer addresses or persisted DNS children
features.maintenance: attributable failures fill the window, blocked paths are periodically probed and a successful probe resets suppression; cancellation and local failures remain neutral
features.diagnostics: node diagnostics forwards the scheduler IPv6 state, request/outcome/success counters and next-probe position outside the node mutex
features.intended_disposition: retain native/private node integration with readiness unverified until final-head acceptance; black_hole_detector_udp_and_ipv6_tcp_complete_failure_and_recovery_cycle and dial_scheduler_udp_and_ipv6_tcp_recover_after_successful_black_hole_probe exercise IPv6 TCP suppression/reset and resource ownership with scripted attempts; they are component evidence, not a real-network outage or donor wire experiment
